blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】快適な町
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Comfortable Towns

blocks.source: ここでは、快適性を重視した町の作成について記述する。
blocks.translation: This section discusses creating towns with an emphasis on comfort and convenience.

blocks.source: ダンジョンについては、ゲームバランスの記事で既に述べているため重ねては書かないが、基本的な考え方は同じとなる。
blocks.translation: I have already discussed dungeons in the article on game balance, so I will not repeat that discussion here, but the basic principles are the same.

blocks.source: 町の大きさ
blocks.translation: Town Size

blocks.source: 町を作るにおいてはまず「必要な施設」「必要な情報とそれをもたらす町人」を決めておこう。それらが自然に配置できるような規模で町を作れば、悪くはないと思う。町の大きさは少し小さめという程度でも構わない。その方が目的の施設・人を探すのに手間が掛からない。
blocks.translation: When creating a town, first decide on the “necessary facilities” and the “necessary information and the townspeople who provide it.” I think it is best to make the town large enough to accommodate them naturally. It is fine for the town to be somewhat small. That way, players will not have to spend much time searching for the facilities and people they need.

blocks.source: 逆に町が広すぎる場合は明確な弊害がある。
blocks.translation: Conversely, making a town too large has clear drawbacks.

blocks.source: 第一に目的の施設や人を探すのに、プレイヤーが苦労する。第二に制作者にとっても工数の無駄になる。せっかく時間を掛けて製作した広大なマップが逆にプレイヤーの不満になってしまうなど、まさに徒労という他ない。特にゲーム制作でお金を稼ぐプロならば、こういう無駄は赤字や納期遅れの原因となってしまう。
blocks.translation: First, players will have difficulty finding the facilities and people they are looking for. Second, it is also a waste of the developer’s time. Spending a great deal of time creating a vast map only for it to frustrate players is nothing but wasted effort. This is especially true for professionals who make money creating games, as such waste can lead to losses or missed deadlines.

blocks.source: 余計な空間に注意！
blocks.translation: Watch Out for Unnecessary Space!

blocks.source: 町を作る際、大きさと同様に気をつけたいことは余計な空間を作らないこと。
blocks.translation: When creating a town, one thing to be careful about, just as with its size, is not creating unnecessary space.

blocks.source: 例えば、人の作品をプレイしていて「町に細い道があったので奥に進んでみたら、何もない行き止まりだった」なんてことがあって『イラッ』とした経験はないだろうか？
blocks.translation: For example, have you ever played someone else’s game and thought, “There was a narrow path in town, so I went farther in, only to find a dead end with nothing there,” and felt annoyed?

blocks.source: 少なくとも僕はありまくる。もちろん引き返すにも同じ時間がかかるので『イラッ』は二倍。移動速度が遅い作品なら、『イラッ』は四倍。かくいう僕は、これが原因でプレイを放棄したフリゲがあったりする。
blocks.translation: At least, I have had that experience plenty of times. Of course, going back takes just as long, so the annoyance doubles. If the game has slow movement speed, it quadruples. In fact, there have been freeware games I stopped playing for exactly this reason.

blocks.source: ともあれ、空間があるとプレイヤーはまず進んでみようと思うもの。その先に何もなければガッカリする。「余計な空間は作らない」もしくは「町人や宝箱を配置する」などで、プレイヤーをがっかりさせないようにしよう。
blocks.translation: In any case, when players see an open space, they naturally want to proceed and see what is ahead. If there is nothing there, they will be disappointed. Avoid disappointing players by either not creating unnecessary spaces or placing townspeople, treasure chests, and so on in them.

blocks.source: これは意外と盲点で、深く考えずデザイン優先で町を作っていると、気付かない内に余分な空間ができてしまうことがある。自分がテストプレイする時は必要な施設だけに行くのではなく、町を端から端へ歩いてみよう。自分が『イラッ』としたなら要注意。
blocks.translation: This is an unexpectedly easy thing to overlook. If you create a town with a focus on design without thinking deeply about it, extra spaces can appear without you noticing. When testing your game, do not just visit the necessary facilities; try walking from one end of the town to the other. If you find yourself getting annoyed, pay close attention.

blocks.source: リアリティは必要？
blocks.translation: Is Realism Necessary?

blocks.source: 時々、「この町は設定上は大都市なのだから、住民は１００人ぐらい欲しい」などと過剰なリアリティにこだわる人がいるけれど、プレイヤーにそのこだわりが伝わるかは怪しいところ。
blocks.translation: Sometimes, people become overly concerned with realism, saying things like, “This town is a major city according to the setting, so it should have around 100 residents.” However, it is questionable whether players will appreciate that level of commitment.

blocks.source: 制作者は「自分が作りたいもの」「プレイヤーにやって欲しいこと」を密度を高めて集約すればいい。それ以外のものをだらだらと作る必要はないと思う。もっとも、住民との会話を重視した作品を作りたいというならば、それも立派な選択だけど。
blocks.translation: Developers only need to concentrate and densely incorporate “what they want to create” and “what they want players to do.” I do not think there is any need to draw out and create everything else. Of course, if you want to make a game that emphasizes conversations with residents, that is also a perfectly valid choice.

blocks.source: 施設の配置
blocks.translation: Facility Placement

blocks.source: 宿屋・武器屋といった主要施設を入口付近に密集させるのは基本中の基本。ちなみに、これはリアリティという面でも矛盾しない。現実でもお店というものは便利がよく、人目に付きやすいところに建てられるものだから。
blocks.translation: Concentrating major facilities such as inns and weapon shops near the entrance is fundamental. Incidentally, this is also consistent with realism. In the real world, shops are built in convenient, highly visible locations.

blocks.source: もっとも、町を過度に大きくしなければ、どこに施設を建てても、さほどプレイヤーの不快にはならないはずだけど。もちろん、施設の外観には看板を付けて、一目で何の施設か分かるようにしておきたい。
blocks.translation: That said, as long as you do not make the town excessively large, building facilities wherever you like should not inconvenience players too much. Of course, you should put signs on the outside of facilities so that players can tell at a glance what each one is.

blocks.source: その他機能
blocks.translation: Other Features

blocks.source: ゲームシステムとして町の移動に便利な機能を作成するのも、快適な町を作る上では有効となる。
blocks.translation: Creating gameplay features that make it convenient to move around town can also help make the town more comfortable to navigate.

blocks.source: 例えば、サガシリーズにはボタン１つで町から脱出できる便利機能がある。マップを開けば、各施設へボタンひとつで瞬間移動できるようになっている作品だってある。そのような配慮をしてみるのも手だろう。
blocks.translation: For example, the SaGa series has a convenient feature that lets you leave a town with the press of a single button. There are also games where opening the map allows you to fast-travel to each facility with the press of a button. Trying to incorporate such conveniences may be a good approach.

blocks.source: 以上。
blocks.translation: That is all.

blocks.source: 今回は特に目新しい内容はなかったと思う。しかし、こういった細かいことの積み重ねが快適性の向上に繋がるので、自分の作品を見直してみて欲しい。
blocks.translation: I do not think there was anything particularly new this time. However, improving comfort comes from accumulating these small details, so I hope you will take another look at your own game.

blocks.source: ていうか、ぶっちゃけあんまし書くことなかったです。思い付いたら、そのうち内容追加します。
blocks.translation: Actually, to be honest, there was not all that much to write about. If I think of anything, I will add more content sometime.
